info.title: eve-pdpa gateway
info.summary: A relay that protects Thai personal data in chat messages before they reach an answering system, and in its replies.
info.description:
Not a LINE webhook target: your chat backend calls it with one JSON format. It checks the message, protects personal data by the named policy, and forwards the protected text, signed, to `forwardTo`. The answering system sends its reply back through `/api/outbound`, which checks it again before it reaches the chat app.

Every request carries an HMAC-SHA256 signature over `${timestamp}.${scope}.${body}`. The scope is the route: `inbound`, `outbound`, `end-session` (signed with `PDPA_SECRET`) and `resolve` (signed with `PDPA_RESOLVE_SECRET`). What the gateway sends on is signed `forward` (to `forwardTo`) or `reply` (to `replyTo`). See API.md for the recipe in any language.

A missing, wrong or stale signature is 401. A timestamp more than 300 s from the gateway's clock is stale. Bodies over 65,536 bytes are 413. Every answer carries `Cache-Control: no-store`.

post.summary: Protect a customer's message and forward it
post.description: Signed for scope `inbound` with `PDPA_SECRET`. The protected text goes to `forwardTo`, signed for scope `forward`.

example.context: ขอเบอร์ติดต่อค่ะ

post.summary: Check the answering system's reply and send it to the chat app
post.description: Signed for scope `outbound` with `PDPA_SECRET`. Send the `policy`, `sessionId` and `replyTo` that came with the forwarded message. Tokens of this session become their masked display; the result goes to `replyTo`, signed for scope `reply`.

example.text: ส่ง OTP ไปที่ [tok:rfdbkfrtnsmbvpsh] แล้วค่ะ

post.summary: Exchange a token for its real value, for an allowed purpose
post.description: Signed for scope `resolve` with `PDPA_RESOLVE_SECRET` — never `PDPA_SECRET`. Called by the code of a tool that needs the real value, never by the AI. Every attempt, allowed or not, is a `token.resolve` audit event. 404 when no policy on this gateway tokenises.

200.description: Answered. `ok: false` with a reason when the token cannot be exchanged.

post.summary: Delete every token of a chat
post.description: Signed for scope `end-session` with `PDPA_SECRET`. Call it when the chat ends. 404 when no policy on this gateway tokenises.

200.description: Every token of the session is gone.

post.summary: The protected message, sent to forwardTo
post.description: Sent by the gateway, signed for scope `forward` with `PDPA_SECRET`. Read the body as text, check the signature, then parse it. Answer 2xx; anything else, a redirect included, makes /api/inbound answer 502. Redirects are not followed.

example.text: เบอร์ [tok:rfdbkfrtnsmbvpsh] ค่ะ

post.summary: The checked reply, sent to replyTo
post.description: Sent by the gateway, signed for scope `reply` with `PDPA_SECRET`. Check it the same way, with scope `reply`. Answer 2xx; anything else makes /api/outbound answer 502.

example.text: ส่ง OTP ไปที่ xxx-xxx-7777 แล้วค่ะ

timestamp.name: x-pdpa-timestamp
timestamp.description: Unix time in seconds, as signed. More than 300 s from the receiver's clock either way is refused.

signature.name: x-pdpa-signature
signature.description: `v1=` followed by lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256(PDPA_SECRET, `${timestamp}.${scope}.${body}`), the body exactly as sent. Scope: the route (inbound, outbound, end-session), or forward / reply for what the gateway sends.

resolveSignature.name: x-pdpa-signature
resolveSignature.description: As `signature`, keyed with PDPA_RESOLVE_SECRET and scope `resolve`.

Policy.description: A policy this gateway was deployed with. Left out: `default`. One that does not exist: 400.

SessionId.description: Your own chat id, issued by your system. Written as sent into every audit event and the token store: a LINE userId or a phone number here puts personal data in the logs, and you answer for it.

Ref.description: Your own message or call id, written into audit as sent to trace an event back.

Destination.description: https only, no user name or password, not a local or private address, and nothing in its path or query that is personal data. Redirects are not followed.

context.description: The other side's last message, read for cue words only ("your account number?"). Never forwarded.

forwardTo.description: Where the protected message goes. Falls back to the deployment's FORWARD_URL; one of the two is required.

replyTo.description: Where the answer should end up. Passed on to forwardTo, which sends it back with its reply to /api/outbound.
Where the checked reply goes. Falls back to the deployment's REPLY_URL; one of the two is required.

policy.description: A policy that tokenises. One that does not: 400.

token.description: As the model copied it: `[tok:…]`, without its brackets, quoted, or the bare id. One token, never a sentence holding one.

sessionId.description: The chat the token was issued in. Another chat: `session_mismatch`.

purpose.description: Why the value is needed, one of the policy's allowedPurposes, such as `otp_send`.

caller.description: Who is asking, for audit, such as `otp-service`.

policy.description: The policy the message was protected by. Send it back with your reply.

text.description: The protected text: `[tok:…]` tokens, masks or placeholders in place of personal data.

replyTo.description: Send it back to /api/outbound with your reply.

text.description: The checked reply, ready for the customer.

blockedBy.description: The entity types that blocked it, such as CREDIT_CARD. Nothing was sent on.

oneOf.description: The policy blocks this message. Nothing was sent on; tell the customer, for example, not to send card numbers in chat.

value.description: The real value, canonical: 0918887777, not ๐๙๑-๘๘๘-๗๗๗๗. Never log it.

Protected.description: Checked. Delivered, or blocked by the policy.

InvalidRequest.description: The request is wrong. Names the field and the rule, never the value.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, wrong or stale signature, or one signed for another scope. One answer for all.

NotChecked.description: The guard could not run. Nothing was sent on. Send it again.

example.message: the message could not be checked; it was not sent on

ForwardFailed.description: Protected, but the destination did not answer 2xx in time. Send it again.

example.message: the protected message could not be delivered; send it again

NoTokens.description: No policy on this gateway tokenises.

example.message: no policy on this gateway tokenises

Error.description: The store or the signature check failed underneath. Try again.

example.message: the token could not be resolved
